request.description:
🔵 BUYER: View all your tour requests

Role: Buyer/Tenant

Status meanings:
- requested: Waiting for owner to view
- pending: Owner viewed, deciding
- confirmed: ✅ APPROVED - You can visit!
- rejected: ❌ Owner declined
- completed: Tour finished
- cancelled: Cancelled
- no_show: You didn't show up

🔴 OWNER: Update tour status (Confirm/Reject/Complete)

Role: Listing Owner

Status options:
- confirmed: Approve tour (buyer can visit)
- rejected: Decline tour
- completed: Mark tour as done
- cancelled: Cancel tour
- no_show: Buyer didn't show

Validation: Can only confirm 'pending'/'requested' tours. Can only complete 'confirmed' tours.
